meta.name: offensive-api-security
meta.description: Comprehensive API security testing methodology covering REST, gRPC, and WebSocket attack surfaces. Addresses the full OWASP API Security Top 10 2023 including BOLA/IDOR, broken authentication, excessive data exposure, rate limiting bypass, BFLA, mass assignment, SSRF, and security misconfiguration. Includes REST-specific attacks such as HTTP verb tampering, content-type switching, and parameter pollution. Covers gRPC exploitation through protobuf interception, reflection API enumeration, and metadata injection. Addresses WebSocket vulnerabilities including origin bypass, message injection, and cross-site WebSocket hijacking. Provides tooling guidance for Burp Suite, Postman, grpcurl, websocat, and mitmproxy. Each technique includes detection signatures and defensive indicators so you understand what artifacts your testing leaves behind. Designed for authorized penetration testing engagements against API-driven architectures.

copy.tagline_en: Test API endpoints for common security vulnerabilities

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按照流程对 API 进行安全测试:先摸清接口和认证方式,再针对 REST、gRPC、WebSocket 三种类型尝试越权、参数篡改、注入等攻击,并输出发现的问题与复现步骤。
howto.when: 当用户要求对 API 进行安全测试/渗透测试,或针对越权、注入等具体漏洞做排查时触发;需有书面授权。

say.text: 帮我测试这个 REST API 是否存在越权访问(BOLA/IDOR)。
say.note: Claude 会按流程替换对象标识符进行测试。

say.text: 用 websocat 检查这个 WebSocket 的 Origin 校验。
say.note: Claude 会给出对应命令并解释结果。

say.text: 用 grpcurl 枚举目标 gRPC 服务的接口。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides authorized API security assessments by mapping endpoints and auth, then testing REST, gRPC, and WebSocket surfaces for OWASP Top 10 issues like BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, and CSWSH, reporting findings with repro steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests an API security assessment, penetration test, or vulnerability check (e.g., IDOR, injection, rate limiting) against an API-driven application, assuming authorization and scope.

say_en.text: Test this REST API for BOLA/IDOR by swapping object IDs.
say_en.note: Claude will craft and run identifier substitution tests.

say_en.text: Use websocat to check Origin validation on this WebSocket endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude will provide commands and interpret results.

say_en.text: Enumerate gRPC methods on the service using reflection.
say_en.note: Claude will show grpcurl commands and guide analysis.
